LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonT.en: The ghost of POKéMON TOWER is\ngone!\pSomeone must have soothed its\nrestless spirit!
LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonT.fr: Le SPECTRE de la TOUR POKéMON est\nparti !\pQuelqu'un a dû apaiser son âme\ntourmentée !

LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCu.en: Those horrible ONYBRIS!\nThey deserve no mercy!\pThat poor CUBONE's mother…\pIt was killed trying to escape from\nTEAM ONYBRIS.
LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCu.fr: Ces horribles ONYBRIS !\nIls ne méritent aucune pitié !\pLa pauvre mère de ce OSSELAIT…\pElle a été tuée en essayant de\ns'échapper de la TEAM ONYBRIS.
